selectionNotes: Select convex pole 1 (139,68), retaining convex pole 2 (348,59). Marciniak et al. (2018), published Table 4, explicitly reports volume-equivalent occultation diameter 130 ±7 km for this convex pole, whereas archive model 1869 declares 140 ±7 km. Use a named publication-scale override to 130 ±7 km and preserve the raw 140-km mesh bytes. The paper says all four convex/SAGE solutions fit the four-chord occultation and thermal data similarly well; the photometry-only nonconvex SAGE pole1 fit is marginally preferred overall. SAGE does not imply resolved imaging. ISAM release follow-up is recorded separately.
